fields.FIR_Description: It was alleged that the complainant received threatening text messages after a financial disagreement. The matter was brought to Tiruppur Central PS on 2025-08-10, while the incident was placed on 2025-08-07 at roughly 12:40. Yogesh Raman approached Tiruppur Central PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000183. Vignesh Balan (mobile 9000000105) was named as a possible person of interest. Udhay Pandian (9000000220) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. Items referenced in the complaint: social media screenshots and mobile phone records.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Social media screenshot; Mobile phone record
fields.Modus_Operandi: Threatening messages allegedly sent after a dispute.
